children: U S Global Investors Inc reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $10.25M and net income of $3.06M, reversing a prior-year loss as diluted earnings per share rose to $0.24 from $(0.03) in FY 2025.
Revenue was $10.25M, compared with $8.45M in the prior year; YoY change 21.3%.
Net income was $3.06M, compared with $(0.33)M in the prior year.
Diluted EPS was $0.24, compared with $(0.03) in the prior year.
Revenue growth of 21.3% was driven by a $1.7M increase in advisory fees from gold and natural resources funds.
Total assets under management expanded 26.3% to $1.67B, supported by ETF inflows and market appreciation in gold, natural resources and travel-focused JETS products.
Investor preference shifted toward ETFs over mutual funds, supporting product momentum across specialized ETFs.
Net investment income increased to $4.15M, reflecting realized and unrealized equity gains and active corporate investment management.
The company maintained a strong liquidity position with cash and securities supporting operations while focusing on distribution growth and expense management.
